etsy.title: Lined Tote Bag Sewing Pattern PDF, Tote With Pocket and Boxed Corners, 3 Sizes, Easy Beginner Sewing, Stofftasche Schnittmuster
etsy.description:
Sew a sturdy lined tote with an inside pocket in an afternoon. Three sizes, from a flat kids' or library bag to a big grocery tote with boxed corners. Beginner friendly, about 2 hours.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• Bag body, pocket and strap pieces, 3 nested sizes: S 30 × 32 cm (flat), M 38 × 38 cm with 8 cm base, L 44 × 40 cm with 12 cm base
• A4 and US Letter print-at-home files with a test square, plus an A0 copy shop file
• Step-by-step sewing guide with fabric amounts and ideas
• Everything in English AND German (Deutsch): two downloads

GOOD TO KNOW
• No seam allowance included: add 1 cm (3/8 in)
• All pieces are rectangles: you can also draw them straight on the fabric
• Small makers welcome: sell the bags you sew (please credit AureliaVenn)

PDF PATTERN ONLY – no physical item is shipped. Photos show the pattern pieces; no sewn sample photo yet.

Drafted with the help of software; sizes checked piece by piece. Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
